about: I've spent 14 years working across banking operations, markets, treasury, risk, and analytics. At Citi, I led teams in FX and derivatives before moving into liquidity management and market risk. Today at KeyBank, I work across Business Banking portfolio management, credit risk strategy, analytics, governance, and automation.

My work usually sits between the data and the operating model: identifying portfolio signals, turning them into decisions, and building the processes and controls that make those decisions stick. That has included everything from settlement transformation and balance-sheet optimization to credit-line strategy, portfolio monitoring, automation, and risk governance.

experience.title: Vice President, Business Banking Portfolio Analytics
experience.functionalTitle: Portfolio Management & Risk Strategy | Business Banking
description: Lead portfolio strategy and risk analytics across KeyBank's Business Banking portfolio, translating portfolio performance and emerging credit signals into executable risk strategies. Work spans revolving credit, line management, collections, portfolio monitoring, adverse-action governance, control design, and automation.

Built analytical frameworks to identify emerging risk before revolving exposures reach full utilization, helping mitigate $2.9M in credit exposure. The work also includes procedures, stakeholder alignment, controls, and implementation across Product, Risk, Operations, and Technology.

careerLetter.label: Professional Profile
careerLetter.headline: Fourteen years in banking, now focused on data and automation.
careerLetter.deck: My background covers operations, markets, treasury, risk, and portfolio analytics. At KeyBank, I use Python, BigQuery, and SQL to improve recurring risk reporting and regulated processes.
careerLetter.positioning: CLOUD AUTOMATION · DATA INFRASTRUCTURE · TECHNICAL MANAGEMENT
openingParagraphs: I have worked in banking for 14 years. I started in FX settlement, where I managed approximately 25 staff, and later led a six-person equity-derivatives product-control team. I then moved into liquidity management, non-trading market risk, and Business Banking portfolio analytics.

At Citi, I led a SWIFT migration that delivered approximately $29M in annual savings and executed approximately $10B in balance-sheet optimization during the 2023 regional banking crisis. I also built Power BI and KNIME reporting for derivatives, developed the Treasury Management Notebook, and automated cash-rebalancing workflows.

Today, I am Vice President, Business Banking Portfolio Analytics at KeyBank. I engineered a Python commentary pipeline using Vertex notebooks and BigQuery, managed a 402 GB SQL query footprint across 36 months of balance ledger history, and resolved a backlog of delayed Regulation B notices through a systems-level process change. The role combines technical delivery with portfolio risk work, procedures, controls, and implementation.
careerLetter.operatingThesis: I tend to work on problems that need both analysis and implementation. I clarify the business decision, build or improve the data process, and help define the procedures, controls, ownership, and monitoring around it.
careerLetter.evidenceIntro: The figures below summarize three of the larger assignments in that progression.
careerLetter.page2Deck: Fourteen years across banking operations, markets, treasury, risk, and portfolio analytics, with current work in Python automation, BigQuery, SQL data infrastructure, and Regulation B process execution.

operatingPrinciples.title: Read the system, not only the metric
operatingPrinciples.paragraph: A portfolio ratio, P&L movement, liquidity position, or process exception becomes useful only in context. I look at how the work moves, where decisions sit, which constraints matter, and how the underlying data was produced.

operatingPrinciples.title: Design the decision and the control together
operatingPrinciples.paragraph: A recommendation is incomplete until ownership, governance, procedures, exceptions, and monitoring are clear. The decision has to work across Finance, Treasury, Product, Risk, Operations, and Technology - not only on paper.

operatingPrinciples.title: Use technology to reduce operating friction
operatingPrinciples.paragraph: Python, SQL, BI, automation, and generative AI matter when they shorten a decision cycle, improve the quality of information, or remove avoidable manual work. The objective is clearer judgment and more reliable execution.

careerLetter.selectedRecordIntro: The selected record shows a progression from people leadership close to the transaction, through markets, treasury, and risk, to portfolio strategy and cross-functional implementation.
closingParagraphs: My background is in banking. The same skills are useful in other large organizations that need reliable data pipelines, recurring financial and risk reporting, governed automation, and coordination across finance, risk, operations, and technology.

I am looking for roles that combine technical management, cloud automation, financial analytics, and operating leadership. The best fit would involve building reliable data processes and working closely with the teams that use them.
